components.description: SIU's Family and Medical Leave policy (all employees) and CBA Section 15.06 apply the federal FMLA: up to 12 workweeks of unpaid, job-protected leave in 12 months for the birth of the employee's child, adoption or foster placement, care of a seriously ill spouse, domestic partner, child or parent, or the employee's own serious health condition. Sick leave or vacation may be used during it; the rest is unpaid.

notes: Governing documents for faculty leave are present: the 2016-2018 Faculty Association collective agreement (tenure and tenure-track faculty of the Carbondale campus, excluding Law and Medicine; Art. 15 Leaves of Absence, 13.03 tenure extension) and the Faculty and A/P Leaves/Absences personnel policy. CBA 3.02: the agreement controls over Board policies in a conflict. The policy's 'Up to six weeks' for a normal delivery is read with CBA 15.01.e, which allows sick leave for a normal delivery and requires documentation for 'additional sick leave', and with 15.01.a (sick leave implemented by administrative guidelines); no conflict found.

No paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave, no modified duties or teaching relief, and no part-time option for new parents in any saved document. The CBA's 'Side Letter for Study of Parental Leave' asks the Joint Benefits Committee to study paid parental leave for primary caregivers, a sick bank and use of sick leave for parental leave (report due 2017-12-01, meeting by 2018-02-01); it grants nothing and is not a component. Its existence confirms that sick leave could not be used for parental leave without a medical reason at the reference date.
The CBA copy is the union's unsigned TA text (12/02/2016); it was accepted as in force on 2018-02-24 (version note), so every component citing it carries version_uncertain.
Statutory baseline: statutory_baseline.csv has no IL rows; US rows: FMLA (c1) and the Federal Employee Paid Leave Act (not applicable).

Birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1) from the birth, with the sick-leave childbirth period (c2, up to 6 weeks, generic employer plan) within it from the start -> accruable sick leave (c3, own balance, unknown length) after c2 -> SURS disability benefits (c4, no duration) after sick leave is exhausted.
Non-birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1) only; accruable sick leave (c3) may be used for illness of an immediate family member, unlinked in time for this role because c2 does not count for it.

General-purpose provisions (U1), counted in no figure: vacation for twelve-month faculty (c5), personal leave without pay (c6), CBA 15.04 other leaves (c7), tenure-clock extension for exceptional circumstances (c8, open list 'e.g. ... or other exceptional circumstances').

Cited but not saved: sick-leave administrative guidelines authorized by the Chancellor; Information on Family and Medical Leave Procedures; applicable Board FMLA policy (CBA 15.06); SURS disability rules; 2016 SIUC Employees Handbook (tenure policies, grievance procedure); SIU Board of Trustees 2 Policies C; Civil Service Leaves/Absences page (staff); University Joint Benefits Committee parental-leave report (due 2017-12-01).

Not components (cannot be used for a birth): sabbatical and professional development leave, release time for A/P staff, disaster relief, school visitation, bereavement and funeral leave, jury duty, military leave, disciplinary administrative leave, furlough days, tenure-clock stop at layoff (19.06.c).
